files.title: Barranquilla Interior Romelio Martínez (pre-remodel original tribune)
files.author: Jdvillalobos

notes: All verified as Estadio Romelio Martínez, centro-norte Barranquilla. photo-1: best exterior — full view of the art déco entrance pavilion (stepped parapet, corner tower) with the curved covered tribuna roof sweeping to the right, street foreground. photo-2: close-up of the déco pavilion showing stepped crown, decorative concrete lattice screens, balcony balustrade and tribune roof edge. photo-3: interior of the ORIGINAL pre-2010s remodel (2007 photo) — full length of the cantilevered roof structure on columns, multicolored concrete-block seating, déco pavilion at right end; valuable record of pre-remodel fabric. photo-4: street-side outer perimeter wall decorated with carnival-dancer murals behind market stalls. Rejected candidates: two post-remodel (2018) bowl shots with crowds and a field-level inauguration event photo — no architectural value.
